name: create_scheduler_event
description: This is used for one time reminders for the user. Example: Remind me at 2pm to pick up coffee.
arguments_prompt:
Create a one-time reminder event.

Required fields:
- title: short name for the reminder
- start_date: when to fire, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (local time)
- payload_message: what to remind about

Defaults (omit unless you have a reason to change):
- task_type: "reminder"
- importance: 3
- sound: "default"

Example:
title: Laundry reminder
start_date: 2024-11-05 14:30:00
payload_message: Remind Bob to pick up laundry
task_type: reminder
importance: 3
sound: default
